lines.zh: 卸了负重，脚步轻得吓人。
lines.en: Weights off, my steps are frighteningly light.
I walk across the tips of the grass.
This ground is too soft; I hold back.
I walk on the grass tips without leaving prints.

lines.zh: 一步出去，人已在十步外。
lines.en: One step and I'm ten paces on.

lines.zh: 我压着气，不让自己浮起来。
lines.en: I keep my ki low so I don't lift off.

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得怎么走。
lines.en: This body still remembers how to walk.
I go around the village so no one's startled.
A thin line of dust rises behind me.
I'm walking ahead of the wind.

lines.zh: 肩上的旧痕，是我自己练的。
lines.en: The old marks on my shoulders are from my own training.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把气沉下去。
lines.en: Step by step, I sink my ki.
I sit cross-legged, waiting for a bowl of food.
My stomach growls, so I press it.
I look at the clouds and think of flying up.
The calluses on my palms are thick.
I draw my ki in to my center.

lines.zh: 有人在远处练拳，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is training far off; I can hear it.
I stay still, and the wind goes around me.
These clothes are still too loose.
I chew a stalk of grass and think.
My knuckles tap the ground, lightly.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，听自己的心跳。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen to my own heart.
Trained this long, and still nowhere near the bottom of it.
I roll my wrists until they crack.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先不动声色。
lines.en: Someone's coming. I'll give nothing away.
You've got a decent ki about you.

lines.zh: 你是来打架的，还是来吃饭的？
lines.en: Did you come to fight, or to eat?
Relax. I'm not serious yet.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，就知道你练过。
lines.en: One look and I know you've trained.
Your stance leaves your right side open.

lines.zh: 想试试？我不会留手太久。
lines.en: Want to try me? I won't hold back for long.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，你退了半步。
lines.en: I smile, and you take half a step back.
Your ki is a little unsettled.

lines.zh: 先报名字，我不打无名的人。
lines.en: Name yourself first. I don't fight nameless people.
I tilt my head and study your fists.

lines.zh: 你这身装备，挡不住我一拳。
lines.en: That gear won't stop one punch from me.
I raise a hand. It's only a greeting.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，有点像从前的我。
lines.en: The way you look at me reminds me of myself once.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你若退，就算了。
lines.en: I step in. If you back off, we're done.
I don't need a weapon. My fists will do.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我一听就知道
lines.en: I know your footsteps the moment I hear them.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你最好准备好。
lines.en: I'll count to three. You'd better be ready.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变了，我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing changed. I heard it.
That hurts. I can still fight.
Even without the weights, that one landed.
I spit the blood from my mouth.
Just a scrape.

lines.zh: 护腕卸了，出手轻快多了。
lines.en: Wrist weights off; my strikes feel light.
Good. You're stronger than I thought.

lines.zh: 卸了重，这一下也没躲开。
lines.en: Weights off, and I still did not dodge that.

lines.zh: 气在肋骨那里卡了一下
lines.en: My ki snags for a moment at my ribs.
I brace a hand on my knee and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我抹了下嘴，抬手示意再来。
lines.en: I wipe my mouth and beckon for more.
Food? Then I'll stop fighting for now.
That spread is three meals for me.
Weights off — I move so much lighter.
Food tastes best after training.
Set it down. I won't be polite.
I'll eat while you talk.

lines.zh: 这么多，是给我一个人的？
lines.en: All this for me alone?
My mouth is full and I want more.

lines.zh: 吃饱了才有力气，先吃一碗。
lines.en: A full belly means strength; one bowl first.
Bowl in hand, my eyes go soft.
You ran into me and I didn't budge.
Sorry, I didn't check my step.
That should have numbed your wrists.
I rein in my step, and the soil sinks half an inch.
I'm like a soft wall.

lines.zh: 卸了负重，我一动就到你面前。
lines.en: With the weights off, one move brings me to you.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，地上的土陷了。
lines.en: I step back and the soil dents.
Our shoulders met.
You're stronger than you look.
After the bump I smile. No harm.
I've only ever made a promise to one person.
This isn't something I'm good at.

lines.zh: 我把手放在心口，算是回答。
lines.en: I put a hand on my chest as my answer.
She's waiting at home; I have to go back.
I scratch my head and can't find words.
This isn't a fight, and it's harder.

lines.zh: 我答应过的事，一定做到。
lines.en: What I've promised, I'll do.
We sit side by side and watch the sky.
Even someone like me has a home.

lines.zh: 这句话，我练了很久才说出口。
lines.en: It took me a long time to say that.
I grab it and stuff it in my mouth.
Don't waste what's on the ground.
I weigh it in my hand. Not light.
I dust it off before tucking it away.

lines.zh: 这是给我的吗？我收下了。
lines.en: Is this for me? I'll take it.
One in each hand, held steady.
Eating this restores a little ki.
I spit the husk aside.
I pick it up and dust it off.

lines.zh: 这点东西，还不够我塞牙。
lines.en: This much won't even fill a tooth gap.
That ki over there just spiked.
I drop the smile and straighten up.
Found you. Don't hide.
This one's interesting.
I shift onto my toes, ready to move.

lines.zh: 打之前，我先看看你的分量。
lines.en: Before we fight, I'll weigh you.
I've locked on. He can't run.
This one deserves some effort.
I raise my ki halfway.

lines.zh: 他先动的手，那就别怪我。
lines.en: He swung first. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 我的目光跟上了他的速度。
lines.en: My eyes have caught up with his speed.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，这次是真的。
lines.en: I smile. This time it's real.
I tap my toe, and the earth cracks first.
I read his openings from above.
Easy. I'll test him first.
I know that stance.
I move with his rhythm.
He's fast. I'm a little faster.
I'm waiting for his second punch.

lines.zh: 他的肩一动，我就知道了。
lines.en: His shoulder twitches and I already know.
Half a step left and his blow misses.
This isn't dodging. It's standing where he won't hit.

lines.zh: 我绕到他侧面，不急出手。
lines.en: I circle to his flank and don't strike yet.
His ki is dropping.

lines.zh: 我卸了配重，手脚都轻了。
lines.en: Weights off — my limbs feel light.

lines.zh: 他每一招都在消耗自己。
lines.en: Every move he makes costs him.
I lift a foot and the ground cracks.
He backs to the trees. No way left.
I press in and give him no time.
I can tell he's about to commit.

lines.zh: 这一瞬间，我能看清每一寸。
lines.en: In this instant I can see every inch of it.
I sink slightly and gather power.
His hands are shaking. I saw.
I'll let him open himself up.
One punch lands on his guard.
I close in and land three in a row.
That punch was a third of my strength.
He blocked it, but his arm is shaking.

lines.zh: 我一脚扫过去，他跳开了。
lines.en: My kick sweeps in and he leaps clear.
My elbow drives in and the air cracks.
It landed, and he's back seven or eight paces.
I pull my fist back and wait for him to rise.
Switch hands; I come from the other side.
That one, I meant.
I knock him down, then pull him up.

lines.zh: 拳头的回声，在林子里荡。
lines.en: The echo of my fist rolls through the trees.
He caught my wrist.
I use his force and flip over him.
On the last blow I held back.
Afterward I shake out my hand.

lines.zh: 我从光里走出来，落了地。
lines.en: I step out of the light and touch down.

lines.zh: 卸了负重，身体轻得不像话。
lines.en: Weights off, my body feels impossibly light.
The ki here is unfamiliar.
My bones settle with a single crack.

lines.zh: 脚下的土，被我的气推开。
lines.en: My ki pushes the dirt away from my feet.
Someone has trained around here.
First, I'll find something to eat.
This sky is a clean blue.
The sun is sharp; I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我感受到几股气，都不弱。
lines.en: I sense several kis. None of them weak.
I've come a very long way.

lines.zh: 身体还在响，骨头在归位。
lines.en: My body still clicks; bones settling.

lines.zh: 这一趟，不知道要打几场。
lines.en: No telling how many fights this trip holds.
I tug my jacket straight.
Wind comes up out of the valley.
I plant my feet and stay still.

lines.zh: 有好对手吗？我有点期待。
lines.en: Any good opponents here? I'm looking forward to it.

lines.zh: 我笑出声，自己都觉得奇怪。
lines.en: I laugh out loud, surprising even myself.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上胳膊，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame licks my arm and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从空中摔下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall out of the air and leave a crater.
Underwater I hold my breath until my lungs burn.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我推出去。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me back.
Something punched into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一股怪力锁住我，动不了。
lines.en: A strange force locks me in place.
My empty stomach echoes when I move.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我咬牙扛住。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我往下坠。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet. I'm falling.
